nodes.name: Postgres - Buscar Hash Atual do Banco

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO fatec_rag_documents (file_name, file_id_gdrive, content_hash, raw_json, categoria, titulo, updated_at)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.fileName }}',
  '{{ $json.fileId }}',
  '{{ $json.contentHash }}',
  '{{ $json.rawJsonSql }}'::jsonb,
  '{{ $json.categoria }}',
  '{{ $json.titulo }}',
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (file_name) DO UPDATE SET
  file_id_gdrive = EXCLUDED.file_id_gdrive,
  content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
  raw_json = EXCLUDED.raw_json,
  categoria = EXCLUDED.categoria,
  titulo = EXCLUDED.titulo,
  updated_at = NOW();

DELETE FROM fatec_rag_vectors_poc 
WHERE metadata->>'file' = '{{ $json.fileName }}' 
   OR metadata->>'file_name' = '{{ $json.fileName }}' 
   OR cmetadata->>'file' = '{{ $json.fileName }}' 
   OR cmetadata->>'file_name' = '{{ $json.fileName }}' 
   OR cmetadata->>'file_id' = '{{ $json.fileId }}';

nodes.name: Postgres - Salvar JSON Puro e Limpar Vetores

parameters.query: SELECT n->'parameters'->>'model' AS active_model FROM workflow_entity w, LATERAL json_array_elements(w.nodes) AS n WHERE w.id = 'vKrMSyZ4jMDtbjW7' AND n->>'type' = '@n8n/n8n-nodes-langchain.embeddingsOllama' LIMIT 1;

parameters.query: UPDATE fatec_rag_documents SET vector_count = (SELECT count(*) FROM fatec_rag_vectors_poc WHERE metadata->>'file' = '{{ $json.fileName }}' OR metadata->>'file_name' = '{{ $json.fileName }}') WHERE file_name = '{{ $json.fileName }}';
